evidence.quote: Birchbank Trust funded the Elm Reach otter census. Camera placement, volunteer counts and the final population report are deliverables of grant OT-42.
Birchbank's Elm Reach reedbed survey is funded under another grant with its own habitat report. It is not part of the otter census, although volunteers use the same river transects.
Field recording: We finished the measurements at Elm Reach. The report can go in now.
The field recording about finishing 'the measurements at Elm Reach' concerned the otter census camera counts and its population report. It did not describe the reedbed measurements.

output.rationale: Both sources mention Elm Reach but describe distinct undertakings—an otter census and a reedbed survey—with unrelated deliverables and reports.
